summary: Busy arterial kerb where some cars park, homes about 22 m behind the hedge.
reasons: Some cars park along this kerb

best_section.where: Sir Fred Schonell Drive south kerb, west of the Avalon Theatre corner

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings are houses 22 m and 24 m behind gardens; flats 5-6 m away further along.
drivers.access_and_room: Parking lane beside the travel lane with a few cars in it; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-lane arterial near a signalled junction.
drivers.convention: A few cars park at this kerb in Esri and QLD, so a van would not stand out much.

flags: Dwellings within 25 m on the same side
sun_shade: Open to the sky; the hedge and trees to the south give some shade.
